brief.topic: Reveal sealed capability evidence for three product modules of a single-user agent collaboration network: M5 execution & workspace isolation (git worktree per task, isolated agent workspace), M6 observability & replay (audit/run logs, events, scorecard, task node inspection), M12 technical design & deployment (architecture substrate, SQLite/persistence layout, local/container deployment). Problem-discovery stage; no adoption ranking.
